manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 223
text:
Page 001
001-1. 一简约一 创艺精品店 时尚一
001-2. GETTINGTHESHAWL OR THE SCARF WOULD BE GOOD, IF THE SUN IS STRONG WHEN FISHING WEARING A HAT AND THIS SHAWL CAN PROVIDE COMPLETE PROTECTION.
001-3. CAN YOU TAKE 500?
001-4. SURE!

Page 002
002-1. SHIT, I WAS CARELESS.
002-2. I MEANT 500 FOR TWO, WITH THIS SKY-BLLE ONE.
002-3. YOUNG MAN, YOU SHOULDN'T BE SO STINGY WHEN YOU'RE OUT WITH YOUR GIRLFRIEND.
002-4. THIS IS MY WIFE.
002-5. TWO FOR 600!I CAN'T GO ANY LOWER!
002-6. DEAL!

Page 003
003-1. yOU KNOW HOW TO HAGGLE?
003-2. JUST THE BASICS, IF IT WERE ALNTIE CHENG, SHE WOULD PROBABLY BE ABLE TO BLY TWO FOR THIRTY YUAN.
003-3. THEN WE'VE SUFFERED A BIG LOSS?
003-4. BUYING A 570 FOR WIFE iS NOT A LOSS.

Page 004
004-1. ILL LET HIM TAKE ADVANTAGE OF ME WITH HIS WORDS, BUT I WON'T LET HIM DO ANYTHING IN BED!
004-2. LET'S GO SEE WHAT'S HAPPENING.
004-3. WHY DID THEY START FIGHTING?
004-4. AYOUNG COUPLE WASOUT SHOPPING TOGETHER AND HAVING FUN, BUT ENDED UP BLIMPINGINTOA LOVER...

Page 005
005-1. HAOZI MUST'VE RUN OUT EXCITEDLY TO WORK OVERTIME TOWORKOVERTIME TO DEAL WITH STUFF LIKE THIS.
005-2. HUH?
005-3. HELLO, OFFICER GU.
005-4. YOU'RE..TAKING OUT YOUR LITTLE SISTER TO HAVE FUN?

Page 006
006-1. GIRLFRIEND, LITTLE SISTER HAS BECOME GIRLFRIEND.
006-2. T/N: Sweet Ho-
006-3. WHAT LITTLE SISTER AND GIRLFRIEND, YOUNG PEOPLE THESE DAYS SURE KNOW HOWTO PLAY.
006-4. PLEASE PAY ATTENTIONTOYOUR SAFETY AND DON'T CALSE TROLBLE, I'LL BE TAKING THESE PEOPLE BACK TO THE STATION FIRST.
006-5. YES SIR! THANKYOU FOR YOUR HARD WORK, OFFICER GU!

Page 007
007-1. WHYDOES IT FEEL LIKE YOU'RE VERY FAMILIAR WITH HIM?
007-2. NOT THAT FAMILIAR.
007-3. I SEE THAT YOU'RE STILL A LITTLE NERVOUS WHENYOU SEE POLICE? YOU'RE LIKE A MOUSE SEEING A CAT. IF I WERE TO BECOME ONE, WOULD THAT...

Page 008
008-1. I PROBABLY WON'T BE NERVOUS ANYMORE.
008-2. THAT WOMAN JUST NOW HAD TWO BOY- FRIENDS?
008-3. PROBABLY NOT JUST TWO...
008-4. THEN HER LEGS WOULD BE TOUCHED EVERY DAY.

Page 009
009-1. I'MJOKING, WALK SLOWER SOMEONE SEEMS TO BE COMING TOWARDS US.
009-2. THE WARRIORESS IS REALLY GOOD ATCRACKING JOKES NOW.
009-3. SHE PROBABLY THINKS THAT WE'LL BUY FLOWERS.
009-4. BIG BROTHER, HOW ABOUT YOU BLY A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS FOR BIG SISTER?
009-5. BIG SISTER?
009-6. FOR SISTER- IN-LAW! IT'S 28 FOR ONE FLOWER AND 88 FOR NINE. AND 88 FOK NINE.

Page 010
010-1. FOR MORE THAN 5 YUAN, YOU'LL HAVE TO ASK HER.
010-2. IF ITWERE THEORIGINAL WARRIORESS,SHEWOULD HAVE REFUSED WITH A PAINED LOOKON HER FACE.FORTHESE FLOWERS WITH NO ROOTSANDCAN'T BEPLANTED, THEY'LLWITHER IN A FEWDAYS AFTER PURCHASE.FOR28YUAN, IT'S BETTER TO BUY SOME PORK..
010-3. BIG SIS, BUY A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS FOR BROTHER- IN-LAW!
010-4. 20 YUAN FOR TWO.
010-5. T/N: Haggling with a kid..as expected of the warrioress!

Page 011

Page 012
012-1. For translation of lyrics, go to genius.com. For translation of lyrics,go to genius.com. T/N: This song is called "Qixi/The Seventh Eve" by Xu Song (English name is Vae Xu). Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z2-I18lm0LY
012-2. Night falk as birds build their bridge for the lovers inthekytheoveikessfothee 的念想
012-3. 皎月归我轻随。 The pale moon returns asI follow softly even the candlelight rejoiceswithitsshadow
012-4. Onthe old street of asmall town,there are,lovers holding handswhile having a night stroll~
